rationale: D3 target ownership only: the macOS, iOS, Windows and Linux plug-in editor hosts, their PluginViewHost factory registration and the shared plug-in frame pipeline (plugin_frame_renderer) move from pulp-view-core into the Pulp-kept pulp-view-tooling target, and the hosted-editor drag categories split out of drag_drop_mac.mm. The abstract PluginViewHost contract stays in view-core. No rendering, design-import, Chromium or packaging behavior changes, and no implementation authority moves.
